title: Polity and title
description: The titles, the offices, and how the polity is named.
html:
THE TITLES

Polity and title

IdeGloss
adan. fall; eldest daughter; chief woman of the family; first daughter
agbilin. lineage
akanin. very old adult: elderly
akpatan. storage house
amain. place of the king; king’s palace (replaces obi). Etymology: Urak Lawoi Kramai.
ànàsin. chief's wife
ben. household; people of the house; fellow-townsfolk
bọ ìlov. clear the village square
chev. wait; watch for; watch over, protect, guard, shelter (in good sense); lie in wait for, ambush (in bad sense)
dadov. lean against; fall upon: Nkwụ afù dàdòli n'enu ụnò (That palm tree fell on top of the house)
duagan. leader of a kindred. Etymology: from di nwe uno – owner of the house.duako – teacher
ebon. sub-clan.
ebonkaadj. clan of crafts
egbòboundary around compound or village; more especially the entrance, shaped like goalposts. It also means bus stop/junction
èzi īlon. precincts of a house
ideana (Ide ana)n. mayor/Chief (replaces Eze). Etymology: Igbo Eze (king).
Ikakan. head of a clan (Uniku). Etymology: Ukwuani Igbo.
iloadv. village square; town square; outside
īlon. road, street (esp. in town), main entrance to a compound
isamawarrior title; brave soldier
isukun. queen’s palace
iyin. queen; from the Igbo stream.
mbemn. warrior. Etymology: Igbo mbem (brave one).
nwikalin. elder sibling, cousin
nwuikalin. elder sibling, cousin
obinzen. ochiga’s palace (like Nri’s obi).
obon. town
ọchịchịn. rule; govern; reign; direct
ochigatown leader title in Ide
ofonan. ide’s title-holders staff of authority. Etymology: Ofo (authority) + ona (masses).
ogben. village (Idemmili/Enuani).
ogbuagun. leopard killer (title).
ogbuevin. cow killer (title).
okpiden. king’s crown.
okpuanan. queen’s crown ("cap of Ana")
okpugon. chief’s cap (eagle cap)
omuadaumuada; daughters of the house/lineage
omunnaumunna; children of the father; kindred
onan. people. Etymology: Idemmili ora & Ikwerre Ohna. The water clan will use ona.
oran. people. Etymology: Idemmili ora & Ikwerre Ohna. The water clan will use ona.
òsẹlẹkingfisher (also a title for fishermen from Iyi (queen)).
ozimessage, traditional title for messenger
unakon. school ("house of wisdom"). Etymology: Replaces uno akwukwo.
unikuclan
unohouse/home
uno-akon. school ("house of wisdom"). Etymology: Replaces uno akwukwo.
